Alright, let me think through this year's plan on my 3 mu.

With only 3 mu and four mouths at home, this land isn't going to make us rich — the off-farm wages carry us. But I've been working this soil for 30 years and I'm not going to waste it. I split my land: about 2 mu I keep in the wheat-maize rotation like most folks around here, and 1 mu I plant in cotton. Cotton brings cash when the price is decent, and the wheat-maize gives us grain for the house plus some to sell.

**Wheat (coming up now from last October's planting, ~2 mu):** I planted Jimai variety in early October, same as last year. I put down compound fertilizer (about 40 kg/mu of 15-15-15) before sowing, and I'll topdress urea at jointing — maybe 15 kg/mu if the crop looks a bit yellow, less if it's already green and thick. The extension station people said 15 kg N/mu is enough but I usually do a little more to be safe, maybe 17-18 total. I'll irrigate three times — once before winter, once at jointing, once at heading. Each irrigation from the well costs me around 30-40 yuan per mu in electricity. Harvest early June. Expecting maybe 420 kg/mu, same as last year.

**Maize (right after wheat, mid-June, ~2 mu):** Tight window — I've got to get the stubble chopped and the seed in within a week of combining wheat. I use a no-till planter that my neighbor rents out, saves me time. Zhengdan hybrid seed, about 40 yuan/mu. I side-dress urea once at the big trumpet stage, about 20 kg/mu, plus a bit of compound at planting. If July is dry I irrigate once, maybe twice. Usually get 480 kg/mu. Harvest late September.

**Cotton (1 mu, plant mid-late April):** Cotton is more work — my wife and I do most of the picking ourselves, and our kids help on weekends when they're home. I use a local variety I've been planting for years. Base fertilizer compound at planting, plus urea topdress at flowering, maybe 12 kg N/mu total. I spray for bollworm 3-4 times through the summer. Irrigate twice in July-August if it's dry. Pick starting September, keeps going into October. If I get 250 kg/mu of lint, I'm happy.

My total cash outlay is the squeeze — fertilizer, seed, electricity, pesticide. I try to keep it under 600 yuan per mu across everything. We don't hire labor; it's all family.
